sloka: स वीरशोभामभजन्महाकपिः समेत्य रक्षांसि निहत्य मारुतिः ।महासुरं भीमममित्रनाशनं यथैव विष्णुर्बलिनं चमूमुखे ।। ६.५६.३८ ।।।।
transliteration: sa vīraśobhāmabhajanmahākapiḥ sametya rakṣāṁsi nihatya mārutiḥ ।mahāsuraṁ bhīmamamitranāśanaṁ yathaiva viṣṇurbalinaṁ camūmukhe ।। 6.56.38 ।।।।

translations.english: Great Vanara, Maruti shone like a triumphant hero and saviour in front of the army, just as Lord Vishnu, the Lord of Devatas shone after killing the foes (demons).
